messages.subject: Polyploid (mixed ploidy) aboot
parts:
Hello Zhian and all,

Our mixed ploidy SSR dataset (2n, 4n, 6n; separate groups = separate species) reads into R correctly using read.genalex, with recode option. We get into problems when generating the tree; genind2genpop() screams an error ("Error in Genid2genpop conversion to genpop not supported for varying ploidy") for either prevosti.dist or diss.dist w.percoent = TRUE option. Please advise how we should go about it.

Thank you,
-Marcin

messages.author: d192ec4b1d416345
messages.subject: Re: [poppr] Polyploid (mixed ploidy) aboot
parts:
Hello,

From the context you provided, I assume you are trying to create a tree with populations as leaves based on a given strata.

FWIW, There is a warning about using the `recode` argument in read.genalex() about this issue: https://grunwaldlab.github.io/poppr/reference/recode_polyploids.html

The solution is to actually pass it through recode_polyploids() twice (once to append the zero and another time to remove it.... yes, I know it's weird):

Here's an example with the Pinf data set that has 2n and 3n individuals:

suppressPackageStartupMessages(library("poppr"))
data(Pinf)
p <- recode_polyploids(Pinf, newploidy = TRUE)
p
## 
## This is a genclone object
## -------------------------
## Genotype information:
## 
##    72 multilocus genotypes 
##    86 diploid (55) and triploid (31) individuals
##    11 codominant loci
## 
## Population information:
## 
##     2 strata - Continent, Country
##     2 populations defined - South America, North America
p2 <- recode_polyploids(recode_polyploids(p, addzero = TRUE))
aboot(p, ~Country, showtree = FALSE)
## Error in genind2genpop(x, pop = strata, quiet = TRUE, process.other = FALSE): conversion to genpop not supported for varying ploidy
aboot(p2, ~Country, showtree = FALSE)
## Running bootstraps:       100 / 100
## Calculating bootstrap values... done.
## 
## Phylogenetic tree with 4 tips and 3 internal nodes.
## 
## Tip labels:
##   Colombia, Ecuador, Mexico, Peru
## Node labels:
##   100, 83, 32
## 
## Rooted; includes branch lengths.


I hope that helps.


Best,

Zhian
